fields.description: The Frappe Cloud site domain, e.g. acme.frappe.cloud. Lowercased on save and used as the record name; it cannot change afterwards.
fields.label: Site Name

fields.description: Display name shown in lists and links, e.g. Acme Corp. Defaults to the site name.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Where site-specific notices go, such as downtime or a domain losing verification. Set and updated by Frappe Cloud.
fields.label: Contact Email

fields.description: The Stalwart cluster hosting every mail domain and account of the site. Fixed once the site exists; the cluster must be active at creation.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Frappe Cloud's own identifier for the site, passed at creation. Only for cross-referencing; nothing here depends on it.
fields.label: Frappe Cloud Reference

fields.description: Unchecked, the site's API key stops authenticating. Archive clears it and Resume sets it again; Suspend leaves it checked so the site gets a 403 naming the suspension instead of a bare 401.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Active serves the API. Suspended keeps the key valid but answers every request with a 403 naming the suspension. Archived is final and required before deletion.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When the site was archived. Set by the Archive action; the site cannot be resumed after this.
fields.label: Archived At

fields.description: Mail Domains the site may hold. Adding one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Domains

fields.description: Mail Accounts the site may hold across all its domains. Creating one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Accounts

fields.description: Mail Groups the site may hold across all its domains. Creating one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Groups

fields.description: Mailing Lists the site may hold across all its domains. Creating one beyond the limit fails. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Max Mailing Lists

fields.description: Off for a site that only sends: its accounts cannot receive, and it gets no groups or lists.
fields.label: Mailboxes Allowed

fields.description: Total disk the site may allocate, in gigabytes: the quotas of its accounts and groups together may not exceed it. 0 means unlimited. Every account and group still needs a quota of its own.
fields.label: Total Disk Quota (GB)

fields.description: Disk quota given to accounts and groups created without one, in gigabytes. Must be above 0 and within the total disk quota. Existing ones keep their own quota.
fields.label: Default Disk Quota (GB)

fields.description: Sent by the site as Authorization: token key:secret with Frappe-Authorization-Source: Mail Site. Generated at creation and never changes.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Stored encrypted and shown once, at creation or after Rotate Secret. Rotating it invalidates the previous secret immediately.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: One per line: the IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, or CIDR ranges, the site's server sends from, as Frappe Cloud reports them. Set, only requests from these addresses may use the site's key; a leaked key is useless elsewhere. Blank accepts any address.
fields.label: Allowed IP Addresses

fields.description: Requests authenticated with the site's key run as this service user. Taken from Mail Settings on every save.
fields.label: Service User

fields.description: Outbound mail of this site's domains leaves through this pool instead of the cluster default. A domain may name its own pool. The pool must belong to the site's cluster.
fields.label: Egress Pool

fields.description: Proves the site owns a domain before the domain is added: the site publishes a TXT record at the domain's apex with the value frappe-suite-verification= followed by this token. Fixed for the life of the site, so every domain it adds asks for the same record.
fields.label: Domain Verification Token
